CANTONMENTS (ELECTIONS AND ELECTION PETITIONS) RULES, 1995
CANTONMENTS (ELECTIONS AND ELECTION PETITIONS) RULES,
1995
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part II, 15th
April, 1995]
S.R.O.306(I)/95, dated 12‑4‑1995.‑‑In
exercise of the powers conferred by section 280 of the Cantonments Act, 1924
(II of 1924) read with subsection (2) of section 20 thereof, and in
supersession of the Cantonment Boards (Election of Vice‑Presidents)
Rules, 1961, and the Cantonments (Elections and Election Petitions) Rules,
1979, the Federal Government is pleased to make the following rules, the same
having been previously published as required by subsection (1) of the said
section 280, namely:‑‑
PART I‑‑INTRODUCTION
AND GENERAL
1. Short title and commencement.‑‑(1)
These rules may be called the Cantonments (Elections and Election Petitions)
Rules, 1995.
(2). They shall come into force at once.
2. Definitions.‑‑In these rules, unless
there is anything repugnant in the subject or context,‑‑
(a) "Act" means the Cantonments Act, 1924
(II of 1924);
(b) "candidate" means a person proposed as
a candidate for, or seeking election as a member;
(c) "contesting candidate" means a validly
nominated candidate who has not withdrawn his candidature;
(d) "election" means election to a seat of
a member held under these rules;
(e) "election agent" means an election
agent appointed by a candidate under sub‑rule (4) of rule 10;
(f) "electoral roll" means an electoral
roll prepared under rule 6;
(g). "member" means member of a Board;
(h) "nomination day" means the day
specified under rule 8 for the nomination of candidates;
(i) "polling agent" means a polling agent
appointed under clause (a) of rule 27;
(j) "polling officer" ,means a polling
officer appointed under rule 26 for a polling station;
(k) "President" means the President of the
Board or, where a Board is not constituted, the Officer Commanding the station;
(1) "Presiding Officer" means a Presiding
Officer appointed under rule 26 for a polling station;
(m) "returned candidate" means candidate
who has been declared elected as a member under these rules;
(n) "Returning Officer" means a Returning
Officer appointed under sub‑rule (3) of rule 9; ,
(o) "scrutiny day" means the day specified
under rule 8 for the scrutiny of nomination papers;
(p) "validly nominated candidate" means a
candidate whose nomination has been accepted;
(q) "voter" in relation to a ward, means a
person whose name appears on the electoral roll for any electoral area in that
ward; and
(r) "ward" means a ward delimited under
these rules.
PART II. ‑‑‑SPECIAL
PROVISIONS
3. Special provisions.‑‑(1) If any
question arises as to the interpretation of these rules, otherwise than in
connection with an election enquiry held thereunder, the question shall be
referred to the Federal Government whose decision shall be final.
(2) If any difficulty arises as to the preparation of
electoral rolls, delimitation of wards or conduct of elections, the Federal
Government may by order do any thing not inconsistent with these rules or with
any provision of the Act which appears to it to be necessary for the proper
preparation of rolls, delimitation of wards conduct of elections.
(3) When, under the provisions of any of these rules,
anything required to be done on a specified day or before the expiry of
specified period, and that day or, as the case may be, the last day of that
period is a public holiday within the meaning of section 25 of the Negotiable
Instruments Act, 1881 (XXVI of 1881), is to be observed as a holiday in public
offices in the cantonment, such thing shall be deemed to have been done in time
if it is done in the cantonment on the next succeeding day which is neither a
public holiday nor a day so observed.
